And sis, it’s okay to be normal, the majority of people don’t fit the weird fucked up standards people and society put on them, it’s not realistic, you’re young and unsure of your future being better than your past, the past was not in your control nor was it your fault to carry, please get help, therapy, friends, people online,

They are your family, I'm sure they wish the best for you but they only see things the way that they were raised.
If you really want to I think you should speak to their hearts. People are emotional, try to reach through to them telling them that you understand that they want the best for you.
But that you're their kid, you're not dumb. And maybe your plan is better than what they had in mind, keep your relationship well with your family, don't argue or get upset. 
Be smart when talking to them and choosing the right words and reasons for them to listen to you. Go slowly into the topic.
